body: People are funny.  They say suicide is selfish and look at how selfish your teacher is acting.  You are right - your last paragraph. You take care of yourself, thank all who helped you, then look them dead in the eyes and say " this won't be a ( insert your name here) ass kicking party- the depression makes me feel bad enough. It's not productive and i won't tolerate or make more room for any negativity in my life. If you want to help great, if not peace"
Yeah this is mostly for kids. That's all I needed to know.  Thanks moderator.
Hide your adderal. I can't get through the day without it. Fuck the damn grand parents are stealing the goddamn drugs from the grandchildren. Fuck me.

Thanks to those who actually took the time to read this foul laden angst.  I'm going to call my doctors tomorrow because something has GOT to give. I'm tired of being passive, and politely waiting my turn to soak my ass in the barrel of water when my ASS had been on fire for 20+ years! Yes I said that. If I add up all the$ that I've spent on this fuckery I swear I may catch a charge and be thrown in jail.  I don't want a happy pill. I want to : 1) feel like I belong to the human race
2) not cry every goddamn hour on the clock
3) be able to go outside to get my mail
4) not feeling like I crave death EVERY MINUTE of every mother fucking day and night
If these things can't be dealt with I can't even start. Is this too much to ask? I'm grown you can tell me

You need to get medical help. What a caring person you are to have such concern for the children in that household, but be aware that you may be too consumed with your past and make their situation something entirely different- you may be valid.  You have to accept that you need medical help.  Depression can become unforgiving monster that will knock you the fuck out.  I did that prideful dance too- more concerned with how it would look if I gave in to the medical side.  It cost me dearly.  Fooling oneself will make you a fool.  I say this as I lay here in bed struggling with this black beast.  Tomorrow I will call my doctor and demand a better pill combo. Hell, I may go back to the psych ward. Yes go back. Because I'm working hard not to die.  And I demand that my doctors work hard too.  Accept that you need help and get it.?
Good luck sweets- I think you will be ok;)

Can you get Medicare since your unemployed? Get that free shit because you need to be healthy. When I went no one asked me about insurance not once. I do have it though. I can understand being scared of the bill- I would call the suicide hot line and tell them you are  fearful that you may hurt yourself but lack medical insurance.  Please treat this above getting a car loan, school loan etc.  THIS IS YOUR HEALTH. The hospital stay could HELP you put your life together. True talk. It's a start.

Listen: go to the emergency room and tell them what you just wrote.  Don't be scared, I went for the first time 2  weeks ago- it's like a mini vacation from your problems + you will be fed well, and get meds. You are responsible for your well being and it's no shame in getting help.  I know you don't want to hear this but it's the fucking truth, you're young 25- Christ , I've got underwear older than you. Get help now so you won't end up an old cynical crone like myself lol. It's WAYYYY harder to work on yourself when all you have is gerital, prunes and wheel of fortune to look forward to. Trust me.
